name: Takanori Matsushita
source:
The butler to the Nishinokura family, and legal advisor as well. His family has served this role since his grandfather. He accomplishes his responsibilities for the Nishinokura family in a cool and hard-boiled manner.

[From [url=http://hunex-play.com/portal/005/eng/index.html]Hunex[/url]]
